d: Silver-grey hair is styled in a short bob with long bangs and a single high ponytail tied with a thin red ribbon. The eyes are a matching silver-grey with a calm, neutral expression, set on a youthful, adolescent face. This slender build is dressed in a traditional sailor-style school uniform consisting of a white short-sleeved blouse with a dark navy blue collar, navy blue sleeve cuffs, and a matching navy blue pleated skirt. Large, grey metallic naval artillery components are strapped to the back and sides of the body.
